goal: Thread an optional `redactor: Redactor | None = None` parameter through `flywheel.audit.stream`, `subscribe`, and `attach_logger`, applying it at the single yield/dispatch point.

constraints: stream, subscribe, and attach_logger accept redactor: Redactor | None = None; default None preserves today's verbatim behavior for all programmatic callers (FR-9, NFR-4).

When a redactor is provided, every yielded/dispatched record passes through redactor.redact before the consumer sees it; ordering, follow semantics, cursor math, and error isolation are unchanged (FR-9).
Apply redaction at the single yield/dispatch seam, AFTER cursor/watermark math reads the original record.sequence, so follow cursors never key off a redacted copy.
In stream() a redactor exception propagates to the caller; in subscribe/attach_logger the existing per-record _dispatch isolation applies (a raising redactor is reported, not fatal).
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on src/flywheel/audit/__init__.py and fix all type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not change the default behavior of any existing caller.
edge_cases: redactor=None must be byte-for-byte identical to the pre-change behavior.
Redaction must preserve record.sequence so follow/cursor advancement is unaffected.

graders.run: uv run python -c "import inspect; from flywheel.audit import stream, subscribe, attach_logger; assert all('redactor' in inspect.signature(f).parameters for f in (stream, subscribe, attach_logger))"
graders.name: redactor-kwarg
